import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class ModNum {
        private int v;

        public ModNum() {
            v = 0;
        }

        public ModNum(long v_) {
            v = (int) (v_ % (int) (1e9 + 7));
            if (v < 0) v += (int) (1e9 + 7);
        }

        public int value() {
            return v;
        }

        public static int MOD = (int) (1e9 + 7);

        public ModNum inv() {
            ModNum res = new ModNum();
            res.v = modinv(v, MOD);
            return res;
        }

        public static int modinv(int a, int m) {
            assert (m > 0);
            if (m == 1) return 0;
            a %= m;
            if (a < 0) a += m;
            assert (a != 0);
            if (a == 1) return 1;
            return m - modinv(m, a) * m / a;
        }

        public ModNum add(ModNum o) {
            v += o.v;
            if (v >= MOD) v -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public ModNum subtract(ModNum o) {
            v -= o.v;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public ModNum multiply(ModNum o) {
            v = (int) (Math.round((double) v * o.v / MOD) % MOD);
            return this;
        }

        public ModNum divide(ModNum o) {
            return multiply(o.inv());
        }

        public static ModNum add(ModNum a, ModNum b) {
            return new ModNum(a).add(b);
        }

        public static ModNum subtract(ModNum a, ModNum b) {
            return new ModNum(a).subtract(b);
        }

        public static ModNum multiply(ModNum a, ModNum b) {
            return new ModNum(a).multiply(b);
        }

        public static ModNum divide(ModNum a, ModNum b) {
            return new ModNum(a).divide(b);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        int[][] p = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            }
        }
        int f = 20;
        int[][] sets = new int[2][1 << f];
        int[][] masks = new int[2][];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) {
                    masks[0] = Arrays.copyOf(masks[0], masks[0].length + 1);
                    masks[0][masks[0].length - 1] = (1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k);
                    masks[1] = Arrays.copyOf(masks[1], masks[1].length + 1);
                    masks[1][masks[1].length - 1] = ((1 << n) - 1) ^ masks[0][masks[0].length - 1];
                }
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
            for (int e = 0; e < (1 << (n / 2 * n)); e++) {
                ModNum prob = new ModNum(1);
                int[] edges = new int[n / 2];
                for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) edges[i] = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < n / 2 * n; i++) {
                    boolean r = (e >> i) % 2 == 1;
                    ModNum pp = new ModNum(p[(i / n) * 2 + t][i % n]);
                    prob = prob.multiply(r ? pp : new ModNum(1).subtract(pp));
                    edges[i / n] |= r << (i % n);
                }
                int work_mask = 0;
                for (int a = 0; a < masks[t].length; a++) {
                    int mask = masks[t][a];
                    int[] r = new int[n / 2];
                    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) r[i] = edges[i] & mask;
                    if (r[0] != 0 && r[1] != 0 && r[2] != 0) {
                        if (Integer.bitCount(r[0] | r[1] | r[2]) == 3) {
                            int x = Integer.bitCount(r[0] | r[1]);
                            int y = Integer.bitCount(r[0] | r[2]);
                            int z = Integer.bitCount(r[1] | r[2]);
                            if (x >= 2 && y >= 2 && z >= 2) {
                                work_mask |= 1 << a;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                sets[t][work_mask] = sets[t][work_mask].add(prob);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < f; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
                if ((j >> i) % 2 == 1) continue;
                sets[0][j ^ (1 << i)] = sets[0][j ^ (1 << i)].add(sets[0][j]);
            }
        }
        ModNum ans = new ModNum(0);
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
            ans = ans.add(sets[0][j].multiply(sets[1][((1 << f) - 1) ^ j]));
        }
        ans = new ModNum(1).subtract(ans);
        pw.println(ans.value());
        pw.close();
    }
}
